name: Tsuukin Kairaku ~Chikan de Go!~
source:
Main character is a salary-man who molests every morning and evening. One day his victim congratulates him and wishes him best luck with the contest. It turns out that this train wagon is full of molesters aiming to be the best.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名每天早晚都会在电车上猥亵女性的上班族。某天，受害者竟向他道贺，还祝他在大赛中好运。原来这节车厢挤满了以成为最强痴汉为目标的参赛者。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
